simple.meaning: זָבַח (zâbach) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 134 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 31:54. Its contexts include family, sacrifice, kingship, mountain, wilderness, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָבַח (H2076).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: זָבַח (zâbach) / H2076 is traced through Genesis 31:54, Genesis 46:1, Exodus 3:18, Exodus 5:3 as a generated source-based concept entry.
